title: The pilgrim's journey: the policy questions
description: The policy question each moment of the pilgrim's journey (P0 to P7) raises, one per moment, as questions for a room of origin- and host-country policy makers. A question is a question: the room names who holds the answer today, it does not decide it.
audience: Ministry of Health and pilgrimage-authority policy makers of an origin country and the host country

modules.title: What the journey asks of policy
modules.carries: For each moment: who answers this question in our country today, and is it written down?
objectives: Name, for each moment, who holds the answer today
Say which questions need the origin and host country to agree

presentation.name: Pilgrim IPS
presentation.tagline: International Patient Summary (IPS) • WHO GDHCN • Verifiable Health Links (VHL)
presentation.subject: Verifiable IPS for pilgrimage
presentation.story: Kamal, 61, falls ill in Nalemi on his first pilgrimage, and a Taifafeki doctor reads his medicines and allergies from his Onesan health summary, checked as genuine through WHO GDHCN.
presentation.lede: One pilgrim and the people around him, eight moments, one pilgrimage season. Follow the people first; the technology is what makes each hand-off possible.
presentation.presenterNote: Lead with people, not screens: introduce the cast, walk the eight moments, then open the guide only when the room asks "how does that work?"

about.title: This walkthrough is the story of a FHIR implementation guide
about.text: The same journey is specified in the SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage guide: personas, business processes, the overview of key process flows, and its ArchiMate model.

presentation.closingQuestion: The technology works. What do the origin and host countries need to agree on to make it real?
